METHOD / EVIDENCE HANDLING

Preservation before processing.

The implementation follows the agreed local-first boundary. These are workflow requirements; this release implements only basic local intake and hash verification.

01

Preserve source bytes

Keep a separate original, record acquisition details, and calculate a reference hash. Perform future edits on derived artifacts.

02

Record every transformation

The full application must store parent and result hashes, exact parameters, software versions, operator and timestamps.

03

Approve any transmission

Before a future transcription request, review provider, model, retention terms, purpose and exactly what leaves the device. No provider is connected here.

04

Preserve uncertainty

Keep unclear speech marked as unclear. Treat model hypotheses as hypotheses and preserve the original returned output alongside review edits.

Data boundary in this release

Audio and file bytes
Browser memory only; no application upload
Hashes and manifests
Memory until released; user-initiated download
Supabase
Non-sensitive reference catalog only; no case or evidence tables
Encryption
No evidence vault yet; exported JSON is unencrypted
Identity
Owner-private site access; no Supabase end-user sign-in
No claim of court admissibility, certification or regulatory compliance is made for this development release.
